name: ledger-api
description: Personal Ledger Manager API — exact-decimal ledger engine over Express and MongoDB

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/data && cp src/data/p12-public.json dist/data/

//: typescript and the @types packages sit in dependencies deliberately. The host sets NODE_ENV=production, which makes npm install skip devDependencies, and this service is compiled from source on the deploy box — so its compiler and type definitions are genuine build-time requirements there, not developer conveniences.
